function decryptAes(enc, pass) {
  try {
    if (typeof java.aesDecodeToStr === 'function') {
      var md5 = java.md5Encode(pass);
      return String(java.aesDecodeToStr(enc, md5.substring(16), 'AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding', md5.substring(0, 16)));
    }
  } catch(e) {}
  try {
    var md5 = java.md5Encode(pass);
    var ivStr = md5.substring(0, 16);
    var keyStr = md5.substring(16);
    var cipher = javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance('AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding');
    var keySpec = new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(new java.lang.String(keyStr).getBytes('UTF-8'), 'AES');
    var ivSpec = new javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(new java.lang.String(ivStr).getBytes('UTF-8'));
    cipher.init(javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keySpec, ivSpec);
    var rawEnc = java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(enc);
    var decryptedBytes = cipher.doFinal(rawEnc);
    return String(new java.lang.String(decryptedBytes, 'UTF-8'));
  } catch(e2) {
    return '';
  }
}
var content = '';
var m = result.match(/\.html\(d\(["']([^"']+)["'],[ \t]*["']([^"']+)["']\)\)/);
if (m) {
  content = decryptAes(m[1], m[2]);
}
if (!content) {
  try {
    content = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result).select('.RBGsectionThree-content').html();
  } catch(e3) {}
}
String(content).replace(/[\u200b-\u200f\u00ad\ufeff]/g, '').trim();
</js>

var a = result.selectFirst('a');

if (a) {
  var list = a.attributes().asList();
  for (var i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
    var attr = list.get(i);
    var k = String(attr.getKey());
    var v = String(attr.getValue());
    if (k.indexOf('data-c') === 0 && (v.length < 10 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(v))) {
      title = v;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!title) title = a.text();
}
String(title).replace(/[\u200b-\u200f\u00ad\ufeff]/g, '').trim();

function b64(s) {
  var c = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=';
  var o = '', b, bc = 0, bs, idx = 0;
  s = String(s).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]/g, '');
  while (idx < s.length) {
    var e1 = c.indexOf(s.charAt(idx++));
    var e2 = c.indexOf(s.charAt(idx++));
    var e3 = c.indexOf(s.charAt(idx++));
    var e4 = c.indexOf(s.charAt(idx++));
    var c1 = (e1 << 2) | (e2 >> 4);
    var c2 = ((e2 & 15) << 4) | (e3 >> 2);
    var c3 = ((e3 & 3) << 6) | e4;
    o += String.fromCharCode(c1);
    if (e3 !== 64 && e3 !== -1) o += String.fromCharCode(c2);
    if (e4 !== 64 && e4 !== -1) o += String.fromCharCode(c3);
  }
  return o;
}
var a = result.selectFirst('a');
var url = '';
if (a) {
  var list = a.attributes().asList();
  for (var i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
    var attr = list.get(i);
    var k = String(attr.getKey());
    var v = String(attr.getValue());
    if (k.indexOf('data-c') === 0 && v.length >= 10 && /^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(v)) {
      try { url = java.base64Decode(v); } catch(e) { url = b64(v); }
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!url) url = a.attr('href');
}
String(url).trim();
